guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 在 Axis Hub 创建账号
guide.description: 进入 Axis Hub，使用邮箱、Google、X 或钱包注册。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Create an Account on Axis Hub
guide.original_description: Go to the Axis Hub and sign up with email, Google, X, or a wallet.

guide.title: 了解预训练任务
guide.description: 从 Hub 选择厨房或家庭场景中的抓取、放置、堆叠等任务，操控模拟机械臂。演示按成功率、效率和动作流畅程度评分。原文称失败尝试不会上传，也无惩罚，可重新尝试。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Pick a task from the Hub, such as picking, placing, or stacking objects in a kitchen or home scene, and steer the simulated arm through it. Your demonstration is judged on success, efficiency, and motion smoothness. Failed attempts are never uploaded and carry no penalty, so retry until the run feels clean.

guide.title: 了解后训练任务
guide.description: 由已训练策略尝试任务，你在失败时接管。每次会话的接管预算为 30 秒；未完成任务得零分，策略全程无需接管并完成的任务得分最高。在失败点进行简短、精确的修正得分更好。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Here a trained policy attempts the task while you watch, and you grab control only when it fails. Sessions have a 30-second takeover budget: incomplete attempts score zero, while runs the policy finishes untouched score highest. Short, precise corrections at the failure point score best.

guide.title: 在链上签署任务提交
guide.description: 原文要求在作品集（Portfolio）中，对每个已完成任务在 Base 上签名；签名后才计入 Axis Points。签名内容、手续费及资格仍需核对官方说明。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open your Portfolio and sign each completed task on Base. Signing is what makes a submission count toward Axis Points.

guide.title: 覆盖不同任务场景与技能
guide.description: 多样性按场景和技能两个维度衡量，因此需要兼顾两者，避免重复单一组合。原文称每个账号对每项任务最多计入 5 次完成，超出次数不计分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Spread Your Tasks Across Scenarios and Skills
guide.original_description: Diversity is measured on two axes, the scenes your tasks cover and the skills they exercise, so vary both rather than repeating one combo. The Hub also caps each task at 5 completions per account, and anything past the cap is excluded from scoring.

guide.title: 查看联盟任务与合作方奖励
guide.description: 在联盟（Alliance）区域查看 BitRobot 等生态合作方的任务。原文称这些任务提供 Axis Points，以及按活动规则发放的合作方奖励；是否开放、具体奖励以活动条款为准。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Join Alliance Tasks for Partner Rewards
guide.original_description: Check the Alliance section for tasks built with ecosystem partners such as BitRobot. These pay Axis Points plus a partner reward under campaign terms, the best value per session when one is live.

guide.title: 邀请持续贡献的用户
guide.description: 从 Hub 分享邀请链接。原文称只计算直接邀请用户及其实际产出：无贡献的注册不带来奖励，持续贡献的用户才可能持续计入邀请奖励。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Invite Contributors Who Will Stay Active
guide.original_description: Share your referral link from the Hub. Only direct invitees count, and only through what they produce, so ten inactive signups earn you nothing while one steady contributor keeps paying.

guide.title: 核对 Axis Hub 挑战者任务
guide.description: 在 Axis Hub 的作品集（Portfolio）中查看“Seek the Unseen”徽章，点亮表示在当前白名单。进入挑战者计划（Challenger Program）查看当周任务，完成后按要求签署提交。区域对所有人可见，但只有白名单用户可进入任务界面。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Complete Challenger Tasks in Axis Hub
guide.original_description: Open your Portfolio page in Axis Hub and check the “Seek the Unseen” badge. A lit badge means you are on the current whitelist. Open the Challenger Program zone and review the week’s task list. Complete and sign a task as usual. The zone is visible to everyone, but only whitelisted users can open the task interface.

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
相关活动信息待核实，请查看官方公告。

risks: 项目尚未确认空投，存在投入后无回报的可能。
真实性置信度偏低，证据不足，建议先观察。
任何要求输入助记词、私钥或恢复短语的页面都不可信。
请勿使用主钱包参与实验性项目，避免资产集中风险。
